#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int n, m;

int advance(int s, int x) {
    if (s < m) s += x;
    else s += n - x;
    return s % n;
}

int fullStep(int s) {
    for (int i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        if (s < m) s += i;
        else s += n - i;
        if (s >= n) s -= n;
    }
    return s;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    cin >> n >> m;
    int s;
    long long t;
    cin >> s >> t;
    s--; // convert to 0-index
    vector<int> next(n, -1);
    while (t % n != 0) {
        int x = (int)(t % n);
        s = advance(s, x);
        t--;
    }
    long long cant = t / n;
    int prevs = s;
    while (cant > 0 && next[s] == -1) {
        s = fullStep(s);
        next[prevs] = s;
        prevs = s;
        cant--;
    }
    if (cant > 0) {
        long long cicle = 1;
        prevs = s;
        while (next[prevs] != s) {
            cicle++;
            prevs = next[prevs];
        }
        long long total = cant % cicle;
        for (long long i = 0; i < total; i++) {
            s = next[s];
        }
    }
    cout << (s + 1) << endl;
    return 0;
}
